label: Maximum TTL setting
type: a bucket- or collection-level ceiling on item expiration, overriding a longer per-item TTL.
recurrence_note: Round 15: 2 -> 3 files, by folding `setting:collection-max-ttl` onto this id. A tier in the id is what made the duplicate look like a different thing.
